title: Agtnan: Monster Shutdown Sequence
description:
Non-stop sci-fi survival action
Take control of your robot's destiny in AGTNAN: Monster Shutdown Sequence! Featuring unique maps, themes, and mechanics, you'll need to be quick on your feet and use your wits to survive. Use explosive boxes, warp tubes, moving floors, portals and more to outsmart the enemy and make it to the end. Put those monsters in their place with the Monster Shutdown Sequence - an exciting adventure for robot-lovers of all ages!

Put your skills to the test and navigate through unique arenas full of intense action and thrilling challenges. Outlast waves of monsters with bombs, puzzles, and physics-based mechanics, while exploring fun and exciting theme maps. Experience classic 90s-inspired FPS arenas at your own pace, while mastering each map's danger and traps in order to survive the shutdown.Take on the Monster Shutdown Challenge
• Take on each uniquely designed map with its own set of thrilling elements and obstacles.
• Fight back with powerful weaponry, including explosive boxes that spawn regularly.
• Improve your tech abilities with fallen enemies' Creds and unlock even more powerful features.
• Relive the golden age of arena FPS gaming with classic 90s visuals and mechanics.
description_short: Ready for a robot-battling adventure? Get your hands on Monster Shutdown Sequence and join the ultimate monster-fighting challenge. Experience classic 90s-inspired FPS arenas at your own pace, while mastering each map's danger and traps in order to survive the shutdown.
